windows.title: PhotoCraft for Windows
steps: Choose your architecture
Choose x64 for most Intel / AMD PCs, or arm64 for ARM devices. Match the official installer to your device architecture.
Install or extract
Run the MSI and follow the installation wizard. For the portable ZIP, extract all files before launching the app.
Open your first file
Use File → Open to open an image or a copy of a PSD. Check the layers, then save it as a new file.

mac.title: PhotoCraft for macOS
steps: Get the official DMG
Select the macOS Universal disk image from the official download page. It supports Apple silicon and Intel architectures.
Install the app
Open the DMG, drag PhotoCraft into Applications, then launch it from Applications.
Try it and save a copy
Open an image with File → Open. Save a copy when testing a PSD for the first time. Consult the official installation guide if the system shows a warning.

linux.title: PhotoCraft for Linux
steps: Choose your package
Choose AppImage, DEB, RPM or Flatpak for your distribution and architecture. An AppImage for your architecture is a good starting point.
Allow execution
For AppImage, allow execution as a program in file properties, then launch it. For DEB / RPM, use your distribution’s package installer.
Open and inspect a file
Open a test image with File → Open. Drag and drop may be limited on Wayland; use the menu to open files.

windows.title: PhotoCraft for Windows
windows.format: MSI 安装包 / ZIP 便携版
steps: 选择设备架构
普通 Intel / AMD 电脑选择 x64；ARM 设备选择 arm64。按设备架构选择官方安装包。
安装或解压
运行 MSI 并按照安装向导完成；便携 ZIP 版本先完整解压，再启动其中的程序。
打开第一个文件
启动后通过 File → Open 打开图片或 PSD 副本；检查图层，再另存为新文件。

mac.title: PhotoCraft for macOS
steps: 获取官方 DMG
在官网下载区选择 macOS Universal 磁盘映像，兼容 Apple silicon 与 Intel 架构。
完成安装
打开 DMG，将 PhotoCraft 拖入 Applications（应用程序），再从应用程序中启动。
试用并保存副本
用 File → Open 打开图片；首次测试 PSD 时另存为副本。遇到系统提示请查官方安装文档。

linux.title: PhotoCraft for Linux
steps: 选择适合的包
按发行版与架构选择 AppImage、DEB、RPM 或 Flatpak。新手可先尝试对应架构的 AppImage。
授予执行权限
AppImage：在文件属性中允许作为程序执行，然后启动。DEB / RPM 可使用发行版的软件安装器。
打开文件并检查
通过 File → Open 打开测试图片。Wayland 下拖放可能受限，可使用菜单打开文件。
